items.headline: Citibank commodities head joins Gen10 board
items.summary: Citibank's Global Head of Commodities, Jose Cogolludo, joined the advisory board of agentic CTRM vendor Gen10, lending banking and financing expertise to the platform's development.

items.headline: Trafigura closes upsized $4.4bn loan facility
items.summary: Trafigura closed an upsized US$4.4bn syndicated loan facility, reflecting continued bank appetite for financing large physical commodity traders despite margin pressure in the sector.

items.headline: CMA CGM finalises FedEx Supply Chain deal
items.summary: CMA CGM completed its $1.4 billion purchase of FedEx Supply Chain, adding roughly 150 warehouses and establishing a non-exclusive ocean transport tie-up with FedEx.

items.headline: ACER readies cross-border REMIT investigations
items.summary: ACER confirmed its new cross-border REMIT investigation powers begin in Q4 2026 under a published Rules of Procedure, with completed investigatory reports expected to take several years.
